title: The Intellectual life of the city
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：intellectual　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 intellectual 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the warden wrote of ① an intellectual life of the city in the register, and everybody in the centre said at once that it was ② more intellectual than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the warden, who never explained anything, had done it with great care and gone home; it was the intellectual ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most intellectual life of the city anybody in the centre had ever seen, or so the register for June 1968 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too intellectual to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the resident who had come to help; the intellectual ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the notice at the far gate, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an intellectual talk after dinner, and said that no resident in his right mind would call it ⑥ as intellectual as the talk after dinner they had once had in the old centre. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was intellectual or not, and he said so.

By 1981 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the register. What the line asked for was ⑦ something intellectual, and nothing besides. The resident from the next centre called the whole plan ⑧ quite intellectual; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the register kept the names of the intellectual ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1984, on the same day, she wrote of another intellectual life of the city in the same register, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ more intellectual than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most intellectual talk after dinner in the whole centre, she said in 1986, was the one she could never quite name; the intellectual ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 智力（前置定语 an intellectual life of the city：1974 年管理员在登记册里记下的那件智力的思想生活）
B. adj. 智力／有才智（比较级 more intellectual than：文中两处，一处比城里的思想生活，一处比预想）
C. adj. 智力／有才智（最高级 the most intellectual：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 智力（表语 too intellectual to do：母亲觉得它太智力，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 有才智（前置定语 an intellectual talk after dinner：叔叔把整件事称作一桩有才智的知性交谈）
F. adj. 有才智（同级比较 as intellectual as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩饭后的知性交谈相比）
G. adj. 有才智（后置定语 something intellectual：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 有才智（受程度副词修饰 quite intellectual：那位居民的评价）

items.q: an intellectual life of the city
the most intellectual life of the city anybody
The most intellectual talk after dinner in

answers.why: intellectual 意为“智力”，1974 年管理员在登记册里记下的是“一件智力的思想生活”，此处作前置定语 an intellectual life of the city。
intellectual 意为“智力”，此处用比较级 more intellectual than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
intellectual 意为“智力”，登记册上 六月 那行字说它是社区中心里最智力的一件，故用最高级 the most intellectual life of the city。
intellectual 意为“智力”，母亲认为这件东西“太智力了，谁也用不上”，too intellectual to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
intellectual 意为“有才智”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩有才智的知性交谈”，此处作前置定语 an intellectual talk after dinner。
intellectual 意为“有才智”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩饭后的知性交谈一样有才智”，同级比较用 as intellectual as。
intellectual 意为“有才智”，登记册上那半行字要的是“有才智的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something intellectual。
intellectual 意为“有才智”，邻社区中心来的那位居民认为这套计划“相当有才智”，quite 修饰原级 intellectual。
intellectual 意为“有才智”，1984 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要有才智”，故用比较级 more intellectual than。
intellectual 意为“有才智”，母亲 1986 年说的是“整个社区中心里最有才智的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most intellectual talk after dinner。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1974 年，管理员在登记册里记下了一件智力的思想生活。（an intellectual life of the city）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更智力。（more intellectual than …）
母亲觉得它太智力，谁也用不上。（too intellectual to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩有才智的知性交谈。（an intellectual talk after dinner）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩饭后的知性交谈一样有才智。（as intellectual as …）
到了 1981 年，登记册上只剩半行字：要的是一件有才智的东西。（something intellectual）
answers: In 1974 the warden wrote of an intellectual life of the city in the register.
Everybody said it was more intellectual than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too intellectual to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an intellectual talk after dinner.
He said nobody would call it as intellectual as the talk after dinner they had once had.
By 1981 the register asked for nothing but something intellectual.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 intellectual 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1974 the warden wrote of an intellectual life of the city in the register, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most intellectual life of the city in the centre, or so the register says.
My mother thought it too intellectual to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an intellectual talk after dinner, and nobody argued with him.
The resident from the next centre called the plan quite intellectual, and everybody laughed.
The intellectual ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
